purpose: Machine-consumable architecture model for AI-agent navigation (self-navigable system).

flows.goal: Investigation context -> seeds/ingestion -> observations -> interpretation -> entities/relations/correlations -> entity_stream -> temporal/invariants

rules.description: docs/platform/* must be regenerated via `python -m platform_model.build`; never edit by hand.
Platform docs exclude donors/ per project convention.
ENTITY_TYPE_VALUES in db/schema.py must match domain.ontology.EntityType; test_ontology_and_schema_stay_in_step.
Correlations are possible_match only; never auto-merge identities.
Entity lists/graph must respect investigation_id scope when provided.
